events.label: Sweep
events.note: ts corrected from 320 to ~146. Match clock ticks continuously in this bout (no long freeze like the other two bouts in this batch), so video time tracks match time reasonably well -- but the scoreboard shows Frankland's score is STILL 0 at ts140-145 and is already 4 by ts150, i.e. both of Frankland's 2-point scores land inside the ts145-150 gap, nowhere near the logged ts320/ts530. events.label: Takedown
events.note: ts corrected from 530 to ~148 (see companion Sweep event note -- both of Frankland's scores land in the ts145-150 gap, not at 320/530). Lower confidence than the Sweep correction: the fighters have been continuously grounded since ~ts120 with no clear stand-up visible in the 5s samples, so a true Takedown is not directly confirmed -- but the tight, compressed clinch at ts145 is consistent with a brief scramble-to-feet-and-back that a 5s sampling step would miss entirely. Kept (not dropped) because actor and points are solid via the name-bound scoreboard total (0->4, matching exactly two 2pt scores = the two logged events), and the technique label itself was not contradicted by anything visible, only unconfirmed.
